item.title: Man arrested in Hong Kong over dog found hanging from tree on Tai Po trail
item.description: A man has been arrested in Hong Kong in connection with a mongrel found hanging from a tree on the Wilson Trail in Tai Po, the South China Morning Post has learned. A source said police arrested a 54-year-old man on Sunday evening on suspicion of cruelty to animals, hours after his elder sister alerted them. item.title: Has AI solved the Riemann hypothesis? Claim makes waves at 200th birthday event in China
item.description: A US-based mathematician has stunned the community by claiming to have solved the nearly 170-year-old Riemann hypothesis using artificial intelligence (AI). The news broke on Friday as a major conference opened in southern China’s Shenzhen, where world-leading mathematicians have gathered until Monday to mark the 200th anniversary of the birth of Bernhard Riemann – the German pioneer behind one of the field’s greatest unsolved problems. item.title: Cop31 climate talks collapse as EU and others reject deal
item.description: UN climate talks collapsed on Sunday as ⁠the European Union and others rejected a final draft deal put forward by Cop31 presidents Turkey and Australia, saying it was too weak to advance the fight against global warming. item.title: Hong Kong films shine as Angela Yuen, Anson Kong win at Golden Horse Awards
item.description: Hong Kong actress Angela Yuen Lai-lam has won the best actress prize at the prestigious Golden Horse Awards in Taiwan, while Anson Kong Ip-sang of boy band Mirror has snagged the best supporting actor trophy.
